sources.particles.ts:
// A fixed pool of particles in typed arrays: position, velocity, life and
// hue, in cell units. A dead one is replaced by the last, so the live ones
// are always the first `count`.
export class Particles {
  x: Float32Array
  y: Float32Array
  vx: Float32Array
  vy: Float32Array
  life: Float32Array
  hue: Uint8Array
  kind: Uint8Array
  count = 0
  max: number

  constructor(max: number) {
    this.max = max
    this.x = new Float32Array(max)
    this.y = new Float32Array(max)
    this.vx = new Float32Array(max)
    this.vy = new Float32Array(max)
    this.life = new Float32Array(max)
    this.hue = new Uint8Array(max)
    this.kind = new Uint8Array(max)
  }

  add(x: number, y: number, vx: number, vy: number, life: number, hue: number, kind = 0): boolean {
    if (this.count >= this.max) return false
    const i = this.count++
    this.x[i] = x
    this.y[i] = y
    this.vx[i] = vx
    this.vy[i] = vy
    this.life[i] = life
    this.hue[i] = hue
    this.kind[i] = kind
    return true
  }

  remove(i: number) {
    const last = --this.count
    this.x[i] = this.x[last]
    this.y[i] = this.y[last]
    this.vx[i] = this.vx[last]
    this.vy[i] = this.vy[last]
    this.life[i] = this.life[last]
    this.hue[i] = this.hue[last]
    this.kind[i] = this.kind[last]
  }
}
sources.life.ts:
// Conway's Life on a torus, a cell lit white when it is born and fading
// through teal after it dies. Counted with sliding column sums: three reads a
// cell, not eight. A board that has gone quiet gets a few R-pentominoes.
import { random } from './random'
import { gradient } from './colors'

let cols = 0
let rows = 0
let wide = 0
let now: Uint8Array
let next: Uint8Array
let quiet = 0
let lastPopulation = -1
const RULE = new Uint8Array(32) // (alive << 4) | neighbours -> alive
RULE[3] = 1
RULE[16 + 2] = 1
RULE[16 + 3] = 1

function set(x: number, y: number) {
  x = ((x % cols) + cols) % cols
  y = ((y % rows) + rows) % rows
  now[(y + 1) * wide + x + 1] = 1
}

function sprinkle(count: number) {
  for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
    const x = (random() * cols) | 0
    const y = (random() * rows) | 0
    set(x + 1, y)
    set(x + 2, y)
    set(x, y + 1)
    set(x + 1, y + 1)
    set(x + 1, y + 2)
  }
}

export const life = {
  palette: gradient(256, [[0, 0x000000], [0.4, 0x061b33], [0.85, 0x139c95], [0.99, 0x63f2c8], [1, 0xf4fff9]]),
  textColor: 255,
  embeddedSize: 8,
  hostSize: 4,

  init(w: number, h: number): Uint8ClampedArray {
    cols = w
    rows = h
    wide = w + 2
    now = new Uint8Array(wide * (h + 2))
    next = new Uint8Array(wide * (h + 2))
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++)
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (random() < 0.28) now[(y + 1) * wide + x + 1] = 1
    quiet = 0
    lastPopulation = -1
    return new Uint8ClampedArray(w * h)
  },

  step(cells: Uint8ClampedArray) {
    const W = wide
    const a = now
    const b = next
    // Wrap: the padding rows and columns are copies of the far edges.
    a.copyWithin(0, rows * W, rows * W + W)
    a.copyWithin((rows + 1) * W, W, 2 * W)
    for (let y = 0; y < rows + 2; y++) {
      a[y * W] = a[y * W + cols]
      a[y * W + cols + 1] = a[y * W + 1]
    }
    let population = 0
    let j = 0
    for (let y = 1; y <= rows; y++) {
      const up = (y - 1) * W
      const mid = y * W
      const dn = (y + 1) * W
      let c0 = a[up] + a[mid] + a[dn]
      let c1 = a[up + 1] + a[mid + 1] + a[dn + 1]
      for (let x = 1; x <= cols; x++, j++) {
        const c2 = a[up + x + 1] + a[mid + x + 1] + a[dn + x + 1]
        const alive = a[mid + x]
        const live = RULE[(alive << 4) | (c0 + c1 + c2 - alive)]
        b[mid + x] = live
        population += live
        cells[j] = live ? 255 : cells[j] - 9
        c0 = c1
        c1 = c2
      }
    }
    now = b
    next = a
    quiet = Math.abs(population - lastPopulation) <= 2 ? quiet + 1 : 0
    lastPopulation = population
    if (quiet > 40 || population < cols * rows * 0.02) {
      sprinkle(3)
      quiet = 0
    }
  },
}
